svg.text: Two things the marking on the SSR does not mean

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The SSR body reads EARTH THE MOUNTING RAIL and this build does not run a PE

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: conductor to the DIN rail — the rail is bonded only incidentally, through

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: anodising. If your local rules require an earthed rail that is a mains change,

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: not a bench decision. And the inlet fuse protects the SSR against a short; it

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: does not protect a person — that is the RCD and this PE chain.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every mains connection is made with the C13 cord in another room. Screw terminals (PSU 1 L / 2 N / 3 FG, SSR LOAD 1/2) get VE0508 ferrules; WAGO 221

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: levers take bare stranded core stripped to 11 mm. Fuse rating: (verify on bench) — LDO does not publish the value.
